# BrowOS 1.5
Created by Fouz_312 using Claude (Sonnet 5.5 High). Inspired by the BrowOS project by Allysun.
A desktop-style environment inside an Android app. It does not replace Android.

New in 1.5: Settings > App update. Choose the BrowOS zip you downloaded and the app updates itself, no new APK for changes to the app. If an update does not start properly the app goes back to the built-in version by itself.
Also: crash protection for web pages, lighter graphics, Back and Home keep web apps running (Shut down closes them), remembered full screen per app, key button and sign-in suggestions from Vault, drag an app out of Start to pin it, Chrome-style browser menu, phone notifications, accounts, backup and restore, Camera, Voice Changer (for websites opened inside BrowOS), a secret app, desktop widgets, fullscreen video and file downloads in the browser, keep-running-in-background option, more keyboard shortcuts (Alt+Tab, Ctrl+W, Meta+L, Meta+D, Ctrl+comma, Alt+N, Alt+W).
Folders: www (the app), icons, android-patch (Java files and NATIVE_VERSION), package.json, capacitor.config.json, debug.keystore, .github/workflows/build-apk.yml.
